rationale: The text meaningfully describes deployment, monitoring, management, and lifecycle control of infrastructure. It also says the platform is augmented by 'intelligent systems' without explaining those systems; therefore the conventional non-AI judgment remains weak and forced.
evidence_spans: deployment, monitoring, management, and support of your physical and virtual infrastructure
conflict_response: The ordinary infrastructure-management functions support a conventional interpretation, but the phrase 'augmented by other intelligent systems' is unexplained and could be relevant. It does not itself establish AI, so I retain non-AI as the best-supported binary judgment while marking it weak/forced rather than asserting a supported negative or inferring an implementation.
